name: linear-issue-feature
description: Unimplemented Linear proposal with accepted intent, a proposed mechanism and an unresolved owner decision. Stage test-files/ outside any SKILL.md ancestor; use offline responses without PR revisions. Keep eval.json and oracle/ grader-only.
prompt: /kk:clarify-docs https://linear.example.invalid/export/issue/EXP-18. Save the revised description to issue-draft.md for export maintainers. context.md contains the offline read-only response and sharing declarations; use the supplied files without network access.
trap: Treats a proposed queue as accepted or delivered, invents limits or acceptance criteria, demands a PR/future implementation, imposes bug-report headings or rewrites the tracker title.

assertions.text: The revised reader answers every applicable oracle question from the produced description alone; the need and intended behavior precede incidental mechanism detail.

Separate accepted continuation/download intent, current synchronous export, proposed queue/token mechanism and absent future implementation. Preserve the supplied criterion and checklist states without inventing thresholds, root cause, test results, new criteria or delivery claims.

Retain the unresolved download-expiry decision with Mira as owner and a concrete next step; distinguish proposal comments from accepted requirements and preserve notification exclusion. Do not impose empty reproduction/environment sections.
Preserve the supplied tracker title verbatim if included and suggest no replacement title; description headings may change.
Create exactly one local issue-draft.md, keeping all inputs byte-identical. No network, remote write, implementation edit, command execution, extra summary or ledger.

Read full skill/shared instructions before subject content, then inspect context, body, requirements, discussion and current source. Use the explicit sharing declaration; require neither PR revisions nor future implementation, and do not infer repository access from the Linear link.
